observationMeaning: Post-commit Git state and automatic approval review result; not a new Task/Report production event
commitOutcome: PASS — exact reviewed scope; unrelated drafts excluded
pushOutcome: BLOCKED — automatic approval review rejected execution
automaticApprovalReviewReason: This pushes a large repository commit, including potentially sensitive architecture and evidence, to the unverified origin destination; the user authorized the transition but did not specifically authorize exporting this payload to that remote.
userApproval: Requested for exact transition push; pending explicit reply
reportMaintenance: Same originating activity; original Report timestamp retained; no new HCRL iteration or release increment
